_source: Mock dataset modelled on the IMD Gramin Krishi Mausam Sewa (GKMS) District Agromet Advisory Bulletin schema, issued Tuesdays & Fridays by the Agromet Field Units (AMFU).
issuing_authority: Gramin Krishi Mausam Sewa (GKMS), India Meteorological Department, Ministry of Earth Sciences

IN-UP-LKO.amfu: AMFU, CSA University of Agriculture & Technology, Kanpur

advisories.text: Maintain 5 cm standing water in the field. With 68% rain probability over the next 48 hours, defer top-dressing of urea until the dry spell.
Prop and tie sugarcane clumps against expected 32 km/h gusts to prevent lodging. Ensure drainage channels are cleared.
Scout for pod borer. Spray only after the rain window closes — wait for a 6-hour dry spell.

IN-UP-LKO.livestock: Provide dry bedding in cattle sheds; humidity above 80% raises mastitis risk. Deworm before the monsoon peak.
IN-UP-LKO.horticulture: Stake tomato and brinjal plants. Apply Bordeaux paste on mango trunks against gummosis.

advisories.text: Alternate wetting and drying is advised; groundwater table is falling. Skip irrigation for 2 days after forecast rainfall.
Pink bollworm pheromone traps at 5/acre. Avoid spraying — 22 km/h winds will cause drift losses above 30%.
Earth up rows to improve drainage before the next western disturbance.

IN-PB-LDH.livestock: Ensure 24-hour clean water access; heat load index is in the mild-stress band for crossbred cattle.
IN-PB-LDH.horticulture: Kinnow orchards: apply zinc sulphate spray after the dry window opens.

IN-MH-PUN.amfu: AMFU, Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri

advisories.text: Yellow mosaic vector whitefly active. Install yellow sticky traps; delay foliar spray until wind speed drops below 10 km/h.
Stop irrigation 10 days before harvest. Expected 18 mm rainfall is adequate for the current stage.
Trash mulching between rows will conserve moisture through the forecast dry spell.

IN-MH-PUN.livestock: Chaff fodder to reduce wastage; green fodder availability is adequate this fortnight.
IN-MH-PUN.horticulture: Grape gardens: watch for downy mildew after 2 consecutive wet days.

IN-OD-PRI.amfu: AMFU, Orissa University of Agriculture & Technology, Bhubaneswar

advisories.text: CYCLONE WATCH: Drain fields to 5 cm and harvest any mature crop immediately. Bundle and shift harvested produce to elevated pucca storage.
Remove mature nuts and dry fronds from palms near dwellings ahead of the expected 90 km/h squall.
Provide field drainage; waterlogging beyond 24 hours causes collar rot.

IN-OD-PRI.livestock: Shift livestock to the designated cyclone shelter on higher ground; stock 3 days of dry fodder and drinking water.
IN-OD-PRI.horticulture: Stake banana plants with bamboo tripods and harvest near-mature bunches.

IN-UK-DDN.amfu: AMFU, GB Pant University of Agriculture & Technology, Pantnagar

advisories.text: Terrace bunds should be checked and repaired — 45 mm rainfall expected in 72 hours on steep slopes.
Ensure raised-bed drainage; soft rot spreads rapidly above 85% soil saturation.
Harvest early varieties before the hail-prone convective window (14:00-18:00 IST).

IN-UK-DDN.livestock: Avoid grazing on landslide-prone slopes for 48 hours after heavy rain.
IN-UK-DDN.horticulture: Anti-hail nets recommended for stone-fruit orchards this week.

advisories.text: Soil moisture in the 0-30 cm layer is at 31% of field capacity. One light irrigation advised if canal water is available.
Heat stress likely above 41 °C — irrigate in the early morning to reduce flower drop.
Plan harvest in the next dry window; rain probability is under 20%.

IN-RJ-JAI.livestock: Heatwave protocol: shade nets over sheds, water twice at midday, avoid transporting animals from 11:00 to 16:00.
IN-RJ-JAI.horticulture: Ber and pomegranate: mulch the basin to cut evaporation losses.

default_advisory.amfu: Regional Agromet Field Unit (AMFU) - State Agricultural University

advisories.text: Match irrigation to the forecast rainfall; avoid nutrient application within 24 hours of expected rain to prevent leaching losses.
Plan spraying and harvesting for the identified dry window in the 7-day outlook.
Keep harvested produce covered; ambient humidity favours fungal growth.

default_advisory.livestock: Ensure clean drinking water and shade; adjust feed to weather stress conditions.
default_advisory.horticulture: Inspect drainage in orchards and stake young plants against gusty winds.
